title: Simple Conveyors

# Simple Conveyors
[![Download on Modrinth](https://img.shields.io/badge/Download-Modrinth-1bd96a?style=for-the-badge\&logo=modrinth\&logoColor=white)](https://modrinth.com/datapack/better-peaceful)
[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Join-Discord-5865F2?style=for-the-badge\&logo=discord\&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/xS85W48Cb3)
## Overview
**Simple Conveyors** is a **lightweight** Minecraft datapack that turns **Magenta Glazed Terracotta** into functional **entity conveyors**. When items are dropped or mobs move onto a **conveyor block**, they are automatically pushed in the direction the **terracotta arrow** is facing. This allows you to build simple transport lines for items and mobs without using **redstone**, **water**, or any **additional blocks**.

The system is designed to be vanilla-friendly and easy to use. You only need to place Magenta Glazed Terracotta and orient it correctly. Items and most mobs will then move smoothly across connected conveyor paths, making it useful for farms, storage systems, sorting setups, mob transport systems, and compact automation builds.

Because it reuses an existing block, the datapack blends naturally into survival and creative worlds. It focuses on simplicity and fast setup, so players can quickly create working transport systems without learning complex mechanics.

## Technical Details

- Uses Magenta Glazed Terracotta as conveyor blocks
- Moves items and most mobs
- Players are not affected
- Some entities may be excluded for compatibility reasons
- Applies motion using `data merge entity @s {Motion:[]}` (0.1 speed)
- Direction depends on arrow orientation of the block
- Works in vanilla Minecraft
- No resource pack required
